operation.description: Use this API to approve a buyer's order cancellation request.

parameters.name: cancel_id
parameters.description: The identifier of a specific cancellation request.

parameters.name: idempotency_key
parameters.description:
The idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the server uses to recognize a request. 

You may choose your own method of creating unique keys. We suggest using UUIDs, or another random string with enough entropy, to avoid collisions. 

Idempotency keys can be up to 255 characters long.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
